purpose: Establish whether the dedicated fixture can be read when the CLI is given its recorded session location explicitly. Selecting the location does not repair or verify authentication.

target.name: Seren Harness Test
target.config: ~/seren-harness-live/config.json (private; existing Seren CLI OAuth session by reference)

baseline.last_observed: Inactive synthetic handover example. Recipient must establish a fresh baseline and authorization.

correction.use: only to check whether the read shows the recorded original instruction (a boolean); nothing is previewed or sent

add_to_seren.config_home: Inactive synthetic handover example. Recipient must establish a fresh baseline and authorization.

private_config_change.effect: The harness passes XDG_CONFIG_HOME=<config_home> and SEREN_PROFILE=default to the CLI, overriding the shell's values, and removes SEREN_API_KEY from the CLI's environment. The config digest and the journal binding (cli_session) record the selection. The edit itself makes no call and touches no credential file.

limits.basis: Pinned v0.10.0: managed_agent_get builds the client (cli/src/command_context.rs client -> commands/auth.rs get_bearer_token, which refreshes the OAuth token only when the stored token is near expiry: at most one token request, redirects disabled, and re-saves the session file in the selected config root), then sends one GET. The SDK client (sdk/src/lib.rs from_config) uses reqwest's default redirect policy (up to 10 redirects) and has no retry logic: at most 12 HTTP requests, normally 1 or 2. The 60 s harness timeout kills and reaps the CLI process. One CLI invocation is not guaranteed to be one HTTP request.

execution_environment.shell: Claude's shell tool (as for prerequisite read 1), unless the owner states otherwise when authorizing
execution_environment.executable: the config's seren.executable, pinned by seren.executable_sha256 ddf617c4… (CLI 0.10.0); checked locally before the call; no substitute binary
execution_environment.credentials: the Seren CLI's stored OAuth session for profile default under the configured config_home; selected by location only, never read, copied or inspected by the harness. The CLI may refresh it by itself near expiry and re-save it there. No API key, login or credential change.

evidence.journal: <config state_dir>/prerequisite-read/seren.lifecycle.prerequisite-read.2/journal.json (separate from every earlier journal; binding version 2 includes cli_session)
evidence.kept_on_success: deployment matches target, identity and revision match the baseline (booleans), active_revision_id (UUID only), detail status (allowlisted enum), approval applied (boolean), instruction is the original or the corrected text (booleans), conditions by allowlisted type and state
evidence.kept_on_failure: a fixed classification: category, rule identifier, stage, HTTP status only when parsed from the CLI's own 'unexpected response <code>' format, and source-backed booleans before_main_request / http_response_received (null when not established)
evidence.never_kept: the response, config, secret_keys, stderr, messages, URLs, headers, tokens or any hash of them

stop_conditions: the private config lacks config_home or profile, or local pins, CLI checksum or version differ: refused before any call
a recorded journal whose inputs (including cli_session) differ: refused before any call, journal untouched
after the one read (any outcome, including timeout or interruption): stop; it is never resent
excluded: No cloud deployment status, preview, update, provisioning, Passwords action, start, stop, login, credential repair, permission change, removal of the empty default directories, Discord request, probe or model session. A successful read ends the task; any further step needs its own decision and authorization.
acceptance: Either result read_matches_fixture / read_differs_from_fixture with the safe projection, or result not_read with a fixed failure category (possibly unknown) and its stated uncertainty.
